brief.subject: Diesel jumps 9.7 cents to $6.276; Canada tariff changes Oct. 30
brief.headline: Diesel climbs 9.7 cents to $6.276 as cost pressure squeezes carriers
brief.dek: Diesel rebounds week over week, Marten's Q3 shows cost pain, Canada tariff list shifts and Roadrunner sets a 5.9% GRI.
brief.lede: The U.S. average diesel price rose 9.7 cents to $6.276 per gallon for the week of 2026-10-19, reversing part of a four-week slide.

sections.heading: Diesel Bounces Back
bullets: $6.276 per gallon is the U.S. average retail diesel price for the week of 2026-10-19.
Up 9.7 cents (1.6%) from the prior week, so check that fuel surcharges keep pace.
Still down 25.3 cents over four weeks, but the weekly jump ends the recent relief.
The first Russian diesel shipment is headed to the U.S. after a Trump-Putin deal; pump impact is unclear.

sections.heading: Costs Hit a Reefer Carrier
bullets: 7% drop in Marten Transport shares followed a weak third-quarter report.
Rising fuel and health insurance costs hurt results despite better supply-demand balance.
Small fleets face the same squeeze: tighter markets don't help if expenses outrun rates.

sections.heading: Canada Tariff List Shifts
bullets: Oct. 30: plywood and certain packaging materials come off the 50% Canada tariff list.
Other goods are being added, so cross-border lane volumes may shift by commodity.
Wind turbine imports avoid new tariffs for now; officials have 180 days to report on trade talks.

sections.heading: LTL Rates and Cross-Border Moves
bullets: 5.9% general rate increase from Roadrunner takes effect Nov. 2.
The LTL carrier also launched a new Canada-to-U.S. outbound service.
Shippers facing higher LTL pricing may shift some freight toward partial or truckload options.

sections.heading: Freight Demand Signals
bullets: Drewry's World Container Index rose on trans-Pacific and Asia-Europe routes, pointing to firmer import demand.
More than $1.6 billion in five U.S. plant projects will add trailer, bus, cooling and beverage capacity.
Ryder stock rose 10.49% to $265.53 on solid Q3 as EPA '27 engine rules near.
